subject: CryptoPkg: add some Bn interfaces to build TCG TPM library
reasons: Primarily additive: 980 insertions adding new BigNum API functions across CryptoPkg driver, protocol, and Null library implementations
Adds new functions (BigNumMul, BigNumDiv2, BigNumGcd, BigNumContextStart/End/Get) with consistent implementation stubs across files
While the CALL_BASECRYPTLIB wrapper pattern is structurally uniform, these are new function additions not transformations of existing call patterns
The PcdCryptoServiceFamilyEnable.h changes reorganize Bn service bits but this is a structural refactor of bit assignments not a simple rename
